# three-mesh-bvh 0.8.3

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three-mesh-bvh/-/three-mesh-bvh-0.8.3.tgz

MIT license, included in LICENSE. The bundled ES module's `three` import points
to the project's existing Three.js r170 module; the unavailable source-map link
was removed. No runtime network dependency.

Used for annotation occlusion on private index buffers, without changing the
model's rendering geometry, triangle order, or native material picking.
